name: quality-code
description: From Jira ticket to tests you can trust. Quality Code checks that a ticket is ready to test, helps its author fill the gaps, writes backend tests (Vitest, pytest, JUnit, Go, .NET) and Playwright tests from its acceptance criteria, and grades them with scripts, never with the model. For frontend, backend and fullstack projects.

gitlab_api_url.title: GitLab API URL
gitlab_api_url.description: Your GitLab's API address, ending in /api/v4 (no / at the end). Browser sign-in uses GitLab's own MCP server at this address + /mcp; the token way uses it too. The default is gitlab.com; set your own for a self-hosted GitLab (the connectors card asks for it).

gitlab_token.title: GitLab token
gitlab_token.description: Instead of browser sign-in: a GitLab personal access token with only the read_api scope. Optional. Set gitlab_username too, so the check can confirm the token is yours.

gitlab_username.title: GitLab username
gitlab_username.description: Your GitLab username (without @) or email. Optional. The connectors check confirms the signed-in account (browser or token) is yours and shows it on the card. The connectors card can ask for it in the chat and save it here.

jira_email.title: Jira email
jira_email.description: The email of your Atlassian account. Optional. The connectors check confirms Jira is signed in with it and shows it on the card. The connectors card can ask for it in the chat and save it here.

jira_api_token.title: Jira API token
jira_api_token.description: Optional: an Atlassian API token (id.atlassian.com, Security, API tokens) for the account of jira_email. With it the plugin reads a ticket's .docx files and screenshots, which the Atlassian connector cannot download; it only reads, and only from your *.atlassian.net site.

figma_api_key.title: Figma API key
figma_api_key.description: Optional, instead of signing in to Figma in the browser: a personal Figma access token.

xray_client_id.title: Xray client ID
xray_client_id.description: Optional, for /quality-code:qa: the Client ID of an Xray Cloud API key (Xray, API Keys; a Jira admin creates it). With it, qa reads the tests and sets the run statuses in Xray; without it, qa reads an attached export or the Jira page.

xray_client_secret.title: Xray client secret
xray_client_secret.description: Optional, the Client Secret of the same Xray Cloud API key as xray_client_id.

xray_api_url.title: Xray API address
xray_api_url.description: Xray Cloud's address, where the Xray API key is sent. The default is the global one; for data kept in a region, its regional address, like https://eu.xray.cloud.getxray.app.
